review_notes:
I read the whole file and compared `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso_E7` with its siblings in F4PilotCTSwapNormalize.lean, E8PilotSwapLift.lean, SymplecticPilotParamSwap.lean and E8PilotQ2SwapParam.lean. From about the `lam` construction onward, the proofs match line for line. Only the type tag (`.F4`, `.E7`, `.E8`) and the namespace prefixes differ. A generic version already exists: `SymplecticPilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition` takes an arbitrary group D and an injective ε. It is stated as a Ψ-package and not as a `SwapNeighbourIso`. I did not check the import graph exhaustively. The helper sits in a Symplectic file, so it would need to move into the F4Pilot `Abstract` section of F4PilotCTSwapNormalize.lean. That file is already a transitive dependency of this one, because `F4Pilot.commute_of_map_conj_le_centralizer` and `swapDiagHom` come from it. I have not compiled the proposed rewrite.

The `hq`/`htt` snippets repeated inside this file (and in the high-case theorems) are too short to count under the rubric. `exists_swapDecomposition_high` also looks similar to the E8 and E6 versions. Those parts depend on type-specific lemmas, and I did not find a clean shared statement for them.

findings.problem: Lines 53–112 (from the `lam` construction through the `hrange` and `swap` calc) re-prove a general fact. If Kc and its t-conjugate commute and are disjoint, t²=1, E = Kc ⊔ Kc^t, and E ⊓ C(t) = range ε for an injective ε : D →* G, then there is an injective Ψ : D × D →* G with range E, Ψ(x,x)=ε x and t·Ψ(x,y)·t⁻¹=Ψ(y,x). The block is copied verbatim into at least three other files: F4PilotCTSwapNormalize.lean `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso`, E8PilotSwapLift.lean `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso_E8`, and the generic `SymplecticPilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition` in SymplecticPilotParamSwap.lean. E8PilotQ2SwapParam.lean has a fifth variant (`E8Pilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition`, with ε the identity). Nothing in the copied block depends on E7. The lines `hδrange`, `hδinj`, `lam`, `hc`, `Φ₀`, `hΦ₀apply`, `hrange1`, `hrange2`, `hinj`, `hrange` and the `swap` calc are the same in every copy. Any fix to the argument, such as the `htt` swap calc or `subgroupCongr` rewriting, has to be made in each copy.
findings.proposed_change: Move `SymplecticPilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition` into the `Abstract` section of F4PilotCTSwapNormalize.lean, in namespace `F4Pilot`. That file is already a transitive import here, and SymplecticPilotParamSwap.lean imports it. Its statement stays: `{D : Type*} [Group D] (htt : t * t = 1) {Kc E : Subgroup G} (hcomm) (hdisj) (hE : Kc ⊔ Kc^t = E) (ε : D →* G) (hε : Function.Injective ε) (hfix : E ⊓ centralizer {t} = ε.range) : ∃ Ψ : D × D →* G, Function.Injective Ψ ∧ Ψ.range = E ∧ (∀ x, Ψ (x,x) = ε x) ∧ ∀ x y, t * Ψ (x,y) * t⁻¹ = Ψ (y,x)`. The proof is the existing one (lines 43–81 of SymplecticPilotParamSwap.lean). Then `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso_E7` keeps only the ε setup (lines 47–62: `hε`, `hεinj`, `hεrange`). The rest becomes: `obtain ⟨Ψ, hinj, hrange, hdiag, hswap⟩ := F4Pilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition htt hcomm hdisj hE ε hεinj (hfix.trans hεrange.symm)`. Then `exact ⟨⟨(MonoidHom.ofInjective hinj).trans (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hrange), fun x => by rw [MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply, MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply, hdiag, hε], fun x y => by rw [MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply, MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply, MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply, MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply]; exact hswap x y⟩⟩`. The F4 and E8 `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso*` theorems and `E8Pilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition` can take the same shape. That one is the special case ε = id. In the same way, `SymplecticPilot.exists_swapParam_of_decomposition` becomes a re-export.
findings.benefit: The roughly 60-line group-theoretic argument lives in one lemma instead of at least five copies. The E7, E8 and F4 `nonempty_swapNeighbourIso` proofs shrink to the ε setup and a short packaging step. A reader can see that the only type-specific content is how ε and its range are identified. Later changes to the argument, such as an instance or Mathlib API rename in the `subgroupCongr`/`ofInjective` rewrites, are made once.
